title: Castells
tagline: Build it. Steady it. Crown it.
description: The human towers of Catalonia as a puzzle. Choose who can hold whom tier by tier, steady the tower while the children climb and crown it with the aleta. Campaign, daily and free builds plus Watch & Learn.
howToPlay: Tap people to fill each tier from the bottom up.
Each person must hold the weight of everyone above, shared equally.
Raise the tier when everyone is strong enough, then repeat to the top.
Hold left or right to steady the tower while the children climb.
Tap Aleta when the enxaneta is on top, then take it down safely.
